title: THREE WEEKS OF REHEARSALS. (the drops know the steps.)
format: reel (1080x1920, H.264 High, 30 fps, +faststart, 15.0 s, baked foley in AAC) with a designed 1080x1920 cover; grid tile = cover y 240-1680
caption:
Three weeks of rehearsals on the terrace. The earrings wait on their card, hung from the fairy lights. They know the steps.

The Mint Pear Drop Earrings: from the stud, a short curved line of three small clear pear-cut stones leads down to one larger pear in pale mint, every stone in fine gold tone claws. About 22 mm long, they fall just below the lobe. ₹1,199.

Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.

[ mint pear drop earrings · 18k gold tone plated · five, six, seven, eight ]
first_comment: Tag the cousin who runs the rehearsals. Every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available #NairaFlore #Sangeet #DropEarrings #DemiFineJewellery #NairaPetite
alt_text: An illustrated pink Art Deco building at night. The camera finds its terrace, where strings of warm bulbs come on one by one and their light warms the ledge, a pink paper lantern hangs at the left and three soft dupattas wait on a far clothesline. From a fine fairy-light wire hangs a small blank blush card with a millimetre rule printed down its edge and the words ACTUAL SIZE, holding a pair of drop earrings, first drawn as cream outlines in the dark, then shown as they are: each a short curve of three small clear pear-cut stones leading to one larger pale mint pear in gold-tone claws. The card swings gently on the count beside the words THREE WEEKS OF REHEARSALS, 'the drops know the steps.' A brass plate on the parapet carries the Naira wordmark. The film pulls back to the whole building and ends on a card: Mint Pear Drop Earrings, pale mint and clear cubic zirconia, 18k gold tone plated, ₹1,199, nairaflore.com.
sound: In-app instrumental, no vocals, no chants: a dholki groove at 120 bpm felt as 60 (search 'dholki instrumental', 'sangeet instrumental'), ducked 4 dB under the baked foley. Bring it in at 3.9 s with the sway as a soft pickup, its downbeats on 4.2, 5.2, 6.2, 7.2 and 8.2 s: the card reaches the end of a swing exactly on 5.2 / 6.2 / 7.2 / 8.2 s (FIVE, SIX, SEVEN, EIGHT), where each sparkle lands. Before it only the ambience. Baked (reel.mp4's own track, peak -20 dBFS): 0.0-1.2 s building ambience (street hum, a far scooter, two evening birds), 0.2 s the lift-bell (one soft brass stroke, ~1.2 s decay), 2.2 s and 3.0 s soft switch clicks (the strings, then the near LEDs), 11.3 s the end-card chime.
deviations: Earring studs at tile (738, 650) / (874, 650), 136 px (11.3 mm) apart: the brief's (708 / 852) leaves no room for the rule's labels, and the world's (734 / 878) put the right drop 11.3 px from the card's inset hairline (C-HALO 14). Now 15.0-15.3 px off the hairline, 17.0 px off the rule's ticks (re-measured this pass), 11.1 px between the two drops; each still exactly 264 px = 22 mm.

The far clothesline is rebuilt from AI-18 rather than placed whole: its three dupattas are cut out with their pegs (p10/assets/dupatta-1..3.png, pixels untouched) and the poles, jute line and its little lights are redrawn as SVG. The plate's lights were baked on (and two of its line lights were soft out-of-focus blobs), so the terrace could never be dark; now they are off until the strings' run passes the clothesline (2.6-2.9 s). Fix pass (director 2): the whole group sits 50 px lower than the brief's y 600-800 (AI-18 at (236, 646); pole tops 644.5, feet cy 899, hems y <= 888 on the ledge), because at the brief's height the right pole's top stood 4.6 px under the middle rice LED and the near wire touched it. Not moved sideways. render/v3/README.md's P10 row still lists (236, 596): it is the shared README, so it is not edited here.

The dupattas lift by skewX 3.0 deg about their fold on the line (fix pass, director 4: 1.5 deg moved the hems ~6 px, about 2 px on a phone; now 16-17 px at 1x between 5.52 s and 6.52 s), not the brief's skewY +-1.5 deg, which would tilt the hanging line instead of lifting the cloth; each follows the card's count 0.24 / 0.32 / 0.40 s behind, in over 5.0-5.8 s and out over 9.2-10.0 s. At +-3 deg the pegs stay on the line and the folds hold (checked at 2x and 4x).

Far-wire strings: only THIS terrace's span (19 bulbs) comes on in the reel, left to right, 120 ms each, 70 ms apart (2.20-3.58 s), with the world's own 5.0 s breathing; P11's and P12's spans stay dark, so the pull-back ends on 'the first corner of the terrace strung with lights'. The brief's 'across all three terrace bays' cannot coexist with its dark establishing and find (those spans are on screen until ~2.0 s, and lighting them first would delay this span past 3.9 s). The world's `strings` runs the whole wire from P12's end as one, so the reel holds it at 0 and paints this span's bulbs after each NVW.tick (reel.html only; no shared file touched). Note for P11/P12: the world's default (`strings: null`) lights all three spans once P10 is lit.

C-OUTLINE (fix passes, director rounds 2 and 3) replaces the brief's recipe (one outer-edge contour, sigma 1, approximate_polygon): each earring is one path per stone (three clear pears and the mint pear) plus one short stroke for the gold spine. Each stone is its pixels' convex hull (the line runs on under every claw) blurred sigma 1 (was 3), and each PEAR KEEPS ITS POINT (round 3, fix 2): at a pear's tip the visible pixels stop at the V-prong, so the hull was cut short there and then rounded into a pebble. Now a line is fitted to each flank just behind the cut (the girdle 3-18 % of the stone's length back from the tip, 5-25 % on the larger mint, and only where the girdle runs within 53 deg of the long axis, so the cut's own chord is never taken for a flank); the two lines meet under the prong, and that corner is a real corner: the stone becomes the convex hull of its girdle and the corner, its path starts and ends there, each end Bezier tangent to its flank, nothing smoothed across the point. A tip that would come within 4.5 px of the next stone's girdle (centre to centre: 1.5 px of air between the 3 px strokes) slides back along its bisector until it stands 4.5 px off: clear 2 and clear 3 nestle against the round end of the stone before them, as they sit in the setting, so they open a little (slid 1.2 / 1.5 px left, 3.8 / 1.6 px right). Where under half of a flank's hull points lie on visible girdle pixels (one flank of left clear 2, clear 3 and the mint and of right clear 1; both of the right mint, whose yellow-green pixels beside clear 3 read as gold), the hull's own chord stands in for that flank. The spine now ends AT the mint's corner, where the mint's path begins. The old outer-edge contour is not drawn. Pen order: clear 1, 2, 3, the spine, the mint; 832 px (was 808) at 900 px/s, DRAW_MS recomputed to 925 ms, so the pen runs 1.28-2.20 s. The line stays cream through the retract.

The card in the dark is under a dusky-rose multiply (#9A7E98) that lifts 30 % with the strings and 70 % as the LEDs warm (inout, 3.0-3.9 s). Round 3, fix 1: the multiply now sits UNDER the earrings (card layer order: face, card light, night, contact shadows, earrings, outlines, sparkles), so it darkens only the card face, its hairline, the rule and ACTUAL SIZE.; built after the earrings it had turned the developing mint taupe and the gold dull brown for ~11 frames, at the beat the light finds the piece. The earrings now develop in their own colour from their first frame (opacity and the 6 px -> 0 blur are the develop; nothing tints them). The warm screen light from the right LED (and a little from the middle one) lies on the card under the night. Fix pass (director 3): the terrace now lights on the same ramp: LIGHTS ON's spill (radial 1100 x 800, #FFD9B0 25 %, screen, centred under the near wire at (540, 760)), a pool under each rice LED on the ledge (radial 260 x 120 at y 915, #FFC98A 22 %, not 18 %: at 18 % and the spill's own .55 falloff the ledge lifted 11 levels, short of 15) and a wash over the coping and the parapet's first 150 px (#FFD9B0 16 %). The spill's profile is flat-topped (25 % to half its radius, 0 at its edge) because the ledge lies .4-.9 of the way out. All of it is clipped to the masonry (y >= 800: never the sky, where it would haze the headline) and held under a horizontal envelope that is 0 at tile x 0 and x 1080 (full from 130 px in), so the ledge meets P11's at the joint exactly as before. CLOSED and OPENING(0) carry none of it.

Sparkles: one per count (5.2, 6.2, 7.2, 8.2 s, left / right / left / right), one on screen at a time, the spec's 28 px #FFF7E6 four-point star with its 6 px glow, 0.6 s, scale .6 -> 1.1 -> 0, rotate 0 -> 45 deg. Round 3, fix 3: each now sits on the GOLD BASKET RIM at its mint's lower left, where the photo's gold is deepest: (-16, 252) / (-12, 252) from the stud (tile px). The director's starting point (-36, 242) / (-34, 240) is on the rim's upper end, but half its 40 px surround is still the blush card (1.93 / 1.94:1 measured on the LIT tile), so the point was searched along the rim from there, 20 / 22 px right and 10 / 12 px down (2.46 / 2.68:1). The bloom's centre stop .42 -> .65 and its .4 stop .10 -> .18. No glint band: the counts' one hero movement is the swing.

Beat grid: the swing is A(t) sin(pi (t - 4.7)), so the card reaches the end of a swing exactly at 5.2 / 6.2 / 7.2 / 8.2 s; the in-app track should put its downbeats there (it can enter at 3.9 s as a pickup). The sway's amplitude rises 3.9-5.1 s and dies out 9.2-10.2 s by sine ramps (no overshoot).

The far group's night look (CLOSED and the reel before the strings) is one SVG colour matrix (saturate .8, then R .76 / G .71 / B .80), not the old opacity .55: at .55 the drapes went ghostly on the dusk sky and a plain darkening turned peach and sage khaki. At establishing scale in weeks 1-3 the clothesline now reads as three dim drapes on plain bamboo poles.

Loop seam: from 12.0 s (under the opaque end card) the world is reset to frame 0 with its ambient clock warped by -15 s, so every kandil, bulb wave and ladi meets its frame-0 pose as the card dissolves (final render: seam step 4.19 grey levels, inside the dissolve's own steps, 3.49-4.02).
Cover pose: the ambient clock at 9.05 s, the terrace kandil's flower window square to the street. The end card's bracket is Cormorant 38 (the brief's size for this card), 780 px wide.
Baked foley is synthesized (p10/_build/sfx.py): ambience, lift-bell, two switch clicks, end-card chime, peak -20.4 dBFS in the wav, -20.1 dBFS after the AAC encode (final render); no music is baked.

Caption line 1 is the director's sentence verbatim ('Three weeks of rehearsals on the terrace. The earrings wait on their card, hung from the fairy lights. They know the steps.'), which counts 123 characters, not under 122 as the note expected; it still sits inside Instagram's ~125-character fold, so the whole hook shows before 'more'. No em or en dash and no exclamation mark. The alt text never carried the old clause; it now also says the bulbs' light warms the ledge.
